controls.rule: for octile k and each category c (c = that category's unit group id): a sealed sample of n_k,c rows of c's rows outside octile k (key l8.control, parts (k, c)); if n_k,c > |c| - n_k,c: all of c's rows outside octile k plus a sealed sample of 2 n_k,c - |c| rows of c's rows inside octile k (key l8.control_fill, parts (k, c)); never from another category; the rows shared with octile k are recorded

counts_only: the lead's run prints n and each branch's count only; the record holds ids, counts and hashes

h2a.known_false_positives: '**kwargs' at a line start, '# of' at a line start
h2a.known_misses: en and em dash bullets, '(1)', letter markers, '~~~', '>', inline one-line lists, one-bullet responses
h2a.reading: the reading chosen for an underspecified PLAN-S:162 phrase and a departure from the brief's 'at least one line' (REQ-21 (h))
h2a.rule: a row is an H2a row if at least 2 lines match item, or at least 1 line matches markup, or a line holds fence; n >= 600: a sealed sample of 600 of them (key h2a.sample); else all n plus a sealed sample of 600 - n of the other rows (key h2a.fill)

length.rule: all training rows by (target_tokens ascending, then the sealed rank of registry key length.order over all row ids); octile k = positions 600k to 600k + 599; H1 = octile 0's file (P3); H2b = octile 7's file; H1 under recipe bt reuses H1's file

name: build_length_rules
requirement: REQ-5 (brief rev 1; lead decisions L6, L7; PLAN-S:142, :162, :164)
